name: forward_call_to_routine
description: A two-instruction entry that does nothing except pass control on to one other routine. The attached pseudo-code shows a much larger stream-decoding loop that does not match this entry's size, so the description follows the listed facts.

name: init_channel_period_tables
description: Runs once, while its init flag is still clear: it walks a block of four channel records, storing a data pointer, a halved length and a period per channel, where the period is a fixed clock constant divided by a stored rate. It then fills two 16-word tables with fixed values, sets a few counters and sets the init flag.

name: enable_dma_channels
description: Writes to the DMA control register to switch on DMA channels, based on the register facts listed for this routine. Its pseudo-code could not be produced, so the description rests on that register write and its single caller.

name: return_without_action
description: A one-instruction routine that just returns to its caller, doing no work and touching no state.

name: exit_immediately_no_op
description: Contains only a return instruction, so calling it has no effect.

name: drive_main_program_loop
description: Top-level loop of the raw code region: it first sets a series of state values, then repeats a cycle of many routine calls, touching the interrupt request register and checking a sentinel value to reset the state. Around forty routines are called from here, so it drives the rest of the code.

name: dispatch_on_status_bit
description: Tests bit two of a state byte. If it is set, it calls one pair of routines and returns; otherwise it calls a different pair and returns.

name: scan_entry_table_matches
description: Walks a grid of fourteen rows and nine records of three words each. For each active record it looks up a six-byte table entry and compares its value with two thresholds and an exclusion value, and when the test passes it calls one of two routines chosen by the entry kind.

name: update_entry_table_values
description: Loops over twenty entries of three words each. An entry whose value equals a target, or falls in a range, gets a new value; in two special cases the old value is copied into the last word and that word gets 100 added, and one special new value also sets the middle word to a fixed number.

name: map_low_bits_action_code
description: Takes a byte from another routine, keeps its low three bits, and maps the result to one of several return codes. Two of the mappings also set a state variable and a timer to fixed values before returning, and the other paths call three routines before returning.

name: clear_state_and_setup_blitter
description: Clears several state fields and copies a shared value into four others, then runs a series of setup calls that touch the blitter registers, preparing for a blit.

name: busy_wait_short_delay
description: Counts a 16-bit counter down from one hundred to below zero, doing no other work, which burns a short fixed amount of time before returning.

name: busy_wait_short_delay
description: Counts a 16-bit counter down from one hundred to below zero, doing no other work, which burns a short fixed amount of time before returning.

name: blit_row_grid_passes
description: Runs fifteen passes, each programming the blitter with the same mask and modulo settings and then starting a series of blits: ten of one size and four of another, moving the source and destination pointers each time. The first pass of the series also calls an extra routine when a counter equals seven.

name: configure_blit_parameters
description: Clears a few fields in a structure, sets blitter control values, and selects one of two constant pairs depending on a global flag. It then writes three more size and pointer records from calls and calls one routine.

name: copy_double_buffer_block
description: Copies a block sixteen times, each time ten longwords, across four areas spaced far apart. The source and destination are swapped depending on whether a global flag equals a fixed value.

name: start_fixed_size_blit
description: Clears the blit modulo and control fields, points the destination at a stored value, starts a blit with a fixed size, then calls one routine.

name: start_alternate_size_blit
description: Uses the same blit setup as its neighbour but starts a blit of a different fixed size.

name: start_conditional_blit_pair
description: Returns early if a global flag is zero. Otherwise it writes a stored value, starts a blit with a fixed size, then chooses between two blit setups depending on a state byte, writing position and size records for each.

name: update_state_flag_bits
description: Updates a state byte: it clears the byte when bit two is set, sets it to one when bit three is set and bit two is clear, then returns the state value.

name: compute_bitmap_offset_address
description: Converts a column and a row input into a byte address in a bitmap with forty bytes per row. The row offset is clamped to zero below a threshold, and a fixed offset is added to the result, which is returned to the caller.

name: build_grid_slot_records
description: Walks a fourteen-by-nine grid of records and, for each active cell, either calls a routine to fetch values and writes a four-word slot record, or stores the cell's kind and a computed position into a slot record. Slot records are filled in grid order.

name: scan_for_zero_record
description: Checks up to sixteen records spaced eight bytes apart, starting from a fixed table. It exits as soon as it finds one whose first byte is zero, and otherwise checks all sixteen and returns.

name: process_grid_records_by_kind
description: Walks the fourteen-by-nine record grid and, for each active record that is not the special kind, runs one of several handling branches chosen by its type code. Types four to seven and eleven or twelve get a range check against a computed threshold before a routine is called.

name: start_fixed_blit_sequence
description: Sets the blitter control and modulo registers to fixed values, then starts a fixed-size blit three times in succession, loading the destination pointer from a stored value. It is a fixed setup for a row of blits.

name: start_fixed_blit_sequence
description: Same setup as its neighbour: fixed blitter control and modulo values, then three fixed-size blits in succession with the destination pointer loaded from a stored value.

name: start_multi_channel_blit_sequence
description: Sets the blitter control registers to a fixed mode, loads source and destination pointers from calls, and starts a fixed-size blit three times. The modulo fields are cleared or set to fixed values before the blits start.

name: start_multi_channel_blit_sequence
description: Same blit setup as its neighbour, with the source pointer loaded first, then starts a fixed-size blit three times.

name: merge_masked_sprite_rows
description: Merges sixteen rows of four-plane source words into a bitmap. For each row it first clears destination bits where the source words have no set bits, then ORs in the source bits, across four bitplanes spaced far apart.

name: merge_masked_sprite_rows
description: Same merge as its neighbour, without the initial routine call at the start.

name: blit_sprite_at_position
description: Computes a blit size and a modulo from two position inputs, programs the blitter for a masked copy, then starts several blits of that size, loading the source and destination pointers from calls.

name: blit_sprite_with_mode_change
description: Computes a blit size and modulo from two position inputs and programs the blitter with one control mode, starts a blit, switches to a second control mode and starts another, then loads the pointers.

name: advance_grid_record_positions
description: Walks the record grid and, for records of kind two or three, advances a counter and horizontal position from a stepping table or, when the counter is zero, sets a flag on the record after a routine call. Other records are passed to a further routine.

name: scan_forward_for_free_slot
description: Steps forward through a count of three-word records and stops as soon as one has a nonzero first word. It returns without any result either way.

name: scan_backward_for_free_slot
description: Steps backward through three-word records from a starting point, for a count derived from its input, and stops at the first one whose first word is nonzero. It does nothing when the input equals a fixed limit.

name: transition_shared_state_byte
description: Works on a shared state byte by testing bit masks and ranges to choose the next state, clearing or setting the byte along the way. It calls three routines on the paths that remain.

name: check_values_within_tolerance
description: Returns one when two values are close enough: the second may be at most fifteen above the first or at most twenty-three below it. Otherwise it returns zero.

name: lookup_step_table_value
description: Looks up one word from a fixed table, using the input value doubled as the index, and returns it.

name: step_state_counter_value
description: Advances a state byte. While a secondary counter is active it moves that counter down; otherwise it steps the state byte up or down within a five-bit range and clears a flag bit at the boundary.

name: redraw_playfield_rows
description: Does redraw work chosen by a state value: it may call a routine across a grid, walks a list of records until an empty one, and when a flag bit is set it masks alternate bits across a bitmap in fourteen-word rows.

name: copy_tile_rows_to_bitplanes
description: Loops over a number of rows and, for each row, copies fifteen four-word tile entries from a table into four bitplanes spaced far apart. The source and destination pointers advance after each entry.

name: update_active_record_positions
description: Walks sixteen eight-byte records and, for each active record of the two main kinds, computes a horizontal step from its band, applies it with a limit check, and calls routines to finish the update.

name: decrement_timer_and_clear
description: Counts a secondary timer down while a state byte is nonzero, and clears the state byte when the timer reaches zero.

name: find_record_with_matching_field
description: Scans up to ten six-byte records and returns as soon as one has a second word equal to the input value. Otherwise it returns without a result.

name: stub_empty_return
description: The pseudo-code shows only a return, with no work or calls. The listed instruction count and callers do not match that body, so the description follows the code shown.

name: stub_empty_return
description: The pseudo-code shows only a return, with no work or calls. The listed instruction count and callers do not match that body, so the description follows the code shown.

name: process_flagged_records
description: Walks sixteen eight-byte records and, for each non-empty record whose kind is below four or is the special marker, sets the marker to one where needed and calls one of two routines.

name: blit_clipped_sprite_row
description: Clips a width so that an offset plus width does not exceed a fixed limit, computes blit size and modulo from position inputs, programs the blitter with fixed control values, then starts blits with pointers loaded from calls.

name: run_per_frame_update_step
description: Runs one frame's update: it calls a few routines gated on a flag, advances a frame counter, and while a mode bit is set it resets the counter and places new entries at computed positions by calling routines.

name: step_record_position
description: Moves a record eight units at a time along one axis, choosing the direction from a flag bit and the record's mode field. When a step cannot be made it calls a helper, and it returns the remaining sub-step value.

name: place_record_at_track_position
description: Resets a counter, then positions a record from a global value snapped to a sixteen-unit grid, sets its kind according to a field, and calls routines that check and apply the placement.

name: check_for_nearby_record
description: Looks through a row of ten three-word records for an active record whose position is close to the given one, within a threshold that depends on the record kind. Returns one if one is found and zero otherwise.

name: stub_empty_return
description: The pseudo-code only tests one field of a record and returns in either case, so it does nothing useful on its own. The listed size and calls do not match this body, so the description follows the code shown.

name: run_gated_update_pair
description: Always calls two routines, and additionally calls two more routines when a flag byte is nonzero.

name: swap_two_longword_pairs
description: Exchanges two pairs of longword state values held in shared memory, so each pair takes the other's contents.

name: advance_record_along_track
description: Advances a record along a horizontal track in sixteen-unit steps, in a direction set by a flag, until it reaches its limit, calling a routine at each step. The record's kind field selects which path runs first.

name: run_masked_update_pair
description: Always calls two routines, and calls two more routines when a flag byte is nonzero and bit two of it is clear.

name: scan_track_records_for_hits
description: Chooses a range and step from a record's kind, then walks the eight-byte record table and calls routines for each active record that falls in that range, moving the record along its track.

name: repeat_call_for_count
description: Calls one routine once for each step of a count, from its input value down to zero.

name: interpret_movement_command_stream
description: Reads command words until a terminator. Two commands shift an X position by sixteen units in either direction, another shifts Y, and other values call a routine, sometimes repeatedly until a flag bit is set.

name: interpret_movement_command_stream
description: Same command-stream reader as its neighbour, but it returns its X and Y accumulators directly to the caller once a terminator is reached.

name: run_seven_step_sequence
description: Calls seven routines in a fixed order with no other logic.

name: reduce_value_modulo_step
description: Repeatedly subtracts a step from a value, at most eight times and stopping once the value is below the step, then passes the remainder to a routine.

name: run_five_step_sequence
description: Calls five routines in a fixed order with no other logic.

name: reduce_value_modulo_step
description: Repeatedly subtracts a step from a value, at most eight times and stopping once the value is below the step, then passes the remainder to a routine.

name: check_rectangles_overlap
description: Compares two positions on each axis against per-axis windows, and returns one only when both axes fall inside their windows, zero otherwise.

name: clear_long_table_block
description: Writes zero to a long run of consecutive longword cells in shared memory, clearing a large table in a single pass.

name: clear_record_table
description: Zeroes thirty-two consecutive longwords starting at a fixed table address, clearing the sixteen eight-byte records held there.

name: read_joystick_input_flags
description: Builds an input flag byte from two joystick port registers, setting bits for directional movement and for the two fire buttons. It also keeps a separate fire-button bit in a second flag byte when the first port reports a press.

name: set_and_wait_interrupt_flag
description: Sets a state byte to a fixed value and then spins until that bit is set, waiting for a hardware interrupt request to be signalled.

name: wait_for_interrupt_flag
description: Spins until bit four of a shared flag byte is set, then returns. It waits on the same flag as its neighbour but does not set it first.

name: set_copper_list_pointer
description: Stores the address of a shared buffer into the copper list pointer register, in the same way on both branches of a flag test.

name: wait_then_set_busy_flag
description: Waits until bit six of a shared flag word is clear, then stores a fixed value in that word. The listed register touches are the DMA control registers.

name: toggle_buffer_select_value
description: Flips a shared selector between two fixed values, forty-five thousand and five thousand, depending on its current value.

name: clip_and_merge_sprite_rows
description: Clips a row offset against a fixed limit, then clears destination bits under a source mask and adds source words in across four bitplanes, for a given number of rows.

name: merge_sprite_rows_by_addition
description: Merges a block of source words into four bitplanes by clearing destination bits under the source mask and then adding the source words in, for a given number of rows.

name: copy_block_to_four_planes
description: Copies a block of words from a source buffer straight into four bitplanes spaced far apart, row by row, with no masking.

name: copy_block_to_planes_upward
description: Same plane copy as its neighbour, but it steps the destination back a row each time, so the rows are written in reverse order.

name: compute_bitmap_byte_offset
description: Computes a byte address in a forty-bytes-per-row bitmap from a column and row value, adds a fixed base, and returns it. Unlike its neighbour it does not clamp the row.

name: wait_until_top_bit_set
description: Calls two routines in a loop until the top bit of a shared flag byte is set, then returns.

name: forward_call_to_routine
description: A thin wrapper that calls one other routine and returns, with no other work.

name: copy_color_table_variants
description: Copies sixteen color words into a working table. A second table gets a brightened copy, with each nibble increased by one, when a shared flag is set, and otherwise a darkened copy in which each nonzero nibble is reduced twice.

name: copy_color_variants_by_index
description: Same color-table copy as its neighbour, but the source row is chosen by an index computed from a shared value, and the results go into the same working tables.

name: run_fifteen_step_sequence
description: Calls routines fifteen times in a row, with no other logic.

name: run_six_step_sequence
description: Calls routines six times in a row, with no other logic.

name: run_two_step_sequence
description: Calls two routines in order and passes the register values through to the caller unchanged.

name: start_blit_sequence_modulo_six
description: Programs the blitter with fixed control values and a source modulo of six, starts blits of one fixed size three times, and loads the pointers from calls.

name: start_blit_sequence_modulo_six
description: Same blit setup as its neighbour, with a source modulo of six and three fixed-size blits.

name: copy_tile_column_to_planes
description: Clamps an index to nine and copies one eight-row column of four-byte tile entries from a table into four bitplanes spaced far apart, moving down one row per entry.

name: start_blit_sequence_modulo_six
description: Blit setup with a source modulo of six that starts fixed-size blits three times. It differs from its neighbours only in the routine calls that come before the blits.

name: start_blit_sequence_modulo_six
description: Blit setup with a source modulo of six that starts fixed-size blits three times, after two routine calls.

name: clear_block_or_start_blits
description: If a shared counter is below ten, it clears a block of sixteen rows across four bitplanes. Otherwise it programs a blit with a source modulo of six and starts fixed-size blits.

name: copy_tile_column_offset_a
description: Clamps a shared counter to nine and copies one eight-row column of four-byte tile entries from a table into four bitplanes at one fixed screen offset.

name: copy_tile_column_offset_b
description: Clamps a second shared counter to nine and copies one eight-row column of four-byte tile entries into four bitplanes at a second fixed offset.

name: copy_tile_column_offset_c
description: Same as the first in this family, using the shared counter and writing at a different fixed offset.

name: copy_tile_column_offset_d
description: Same as the first in this family, using the shared counter and writing at another different fixed offset.

name: start_blit_zero_modulo
description: Sets blitter control values and zero modulos, points the source and destination at values loaded from calls, and starts one blit of a fixed size.

name: start_blit_zero_modulo_alt
description: Same as its neighbour but starts a blit of a different fixed size.

name: load_indexed_data_block
description: Copies two hundred thirty-seven words from a table block chosen by a shared index into a fixed working area, one word at a time.

name: save_working_data_block
description: Copies two hundred thirty-seven words from the working area back into the table block chosen by a shared index, the reverse of its neighbour. The listed hardware and call facts describe a larger routine, but the code shown performs only this copy.

name: update_running_checksum_byte
description: Adds several inputs and a current value into a checksum byte, then advances a pointer by two bytes. The pointer wraps back to a start address when it passes a fixed limit.

name: call_when_code_matches
description: Calls one routine only when a code byte is ten or eleven, or the other code byte is five, three or four, or when a value falls outside a window of twenty to forty-three.

name: swap_fifty_longword_regions
description: Exchanges fifty-one consecutive longwords between two fixed memory regions, so each region receives the other's contents.

name: update_running_minimum
description: Keeps a running minimum: when the stored value is zero or the input is at most the stored value, it stores the input and clears an associated byte.

name: update_running_minimum
description: Same running-minimum update as its neighbour, applied to a second stored value with a second associated byte.

name: update_running_minimum
description: Same running-minimum update as the first in this group, applied to another stored word.

name: pause_until_routine_clears
description: Calls a routine and spins through long countdown delays, repeating until that routine returns zero. The listed color register touches are not visible in the pseudo-code shown, so the description covers only the loop.

name: run_pair_of_routines
description: Calls two routines in order and returns.

name: service_three_timed_flags
description: Services three independent state words. When one is active and its companion word is zero, it marks it as started and calls a routine to begin the associated action. When the global flag is clear it resets the state word.

name: shift_and_merge_bitmap_rows
description: Shifts source words by a bit count and writes them into a table as masked values, combining each row's words with a mask derived from the same shift, across several rows.

name: shift_and_merge_bitmap_rows
description: Same shift-and-mask copy as its neighbour, over a longer run of columns per row.

name: shift_and_merge_bitmap_rows
description: Same shift-and-mask copy as its neighbours, over a run of two columns per row.

name: find_matching_active_record
description: Scans sixteen eight-byte records for an active one that passes a test routine. When it finds one it sets a shared flag. It returns two position values either way.

name: update_entry_states_per_frame
description: Walks a table of one hundred fifty entries and updates each active one. Type-two entries wrap a counter down by one hundred, and entries of other kinds are deactivated when a shared flag is clear or when their record is no longer valid.

name: forward_call_to_routine
description: A thin wrapper that calls one other routine and returns the register values unchanged.

name: run_hundred_line_draw_loop
description: Runs a loop of one hundred passes, each calling a routine with a position and size that change from pass to pass, then calls a few other routines and sets a shared state byte.

name: run_pair_of_routines
description: Calls two routines in order and returns.

name: copy_tile_rows_to_bitplanes
description: Loops over a number of rows and, for each row, copies twenty four-word tile entries from a table into four bitplanes spaced far apart.

name: forward_call_to_routine
description: A thin wrapper that calls one other routine and returns, with no other work.

name: run_indexed_movement_script
description: Looks up a command stream by a shared index and runs it. Two commands move a position by sixteen units in either direction, and other commands call a routine, sometimes repeatedly until a flag bit is set. It ends at a terminator and returns the final position.

name: apply_mask_to_four_planes
description: Walks four thousand words and ANDs each source word into the matching word of four bitplanes spaced far apart, using the source word as a mask.

name: draw_nine_row_strip
description: Runs a nine-pass loop that calls routines with a row number and a stepped address on each pass, then calls a few more routines after the loop.

name: apply_sixteen_color_entries
description: Walks sixteen words from a shared block, copying each into a working cell and calling routines to apply it, with an extra call when a shared flag is set.

name: cycle_brightened_color_values
description: When a shared flag is set, runs a cycle of one hundred and one steps over a short color block, brightening each entry by one per nibble and calling routines to apply it. It wraps back to the start at the end of the block.

name: set_timer_to_ten_thousand
description: Stores a fixed count of ten thousand into a shared timer word.

name: set_timer_to_ten_thousand
description: Same as its neighbour: stores ten thousand into the shared timer word.

name: stub_empty_return
description: The pseudo-code is only a return, with no work or calls. The listed size and calls do not match that body, so the description follows the code shown.

name: clear_large_bitmap_block
description: Zeroes a large block of longwords in shared bitmap memory, writing zero across many rows in each of about ninety-eight passes.

name: clear_bitmap_block_offset
description: Zeroes a block of longwords like its neighbour, but over fewer passes and starting at an offset from the buffer base.

name: dispatch_flagged_indexes
description: Walks a five-entry flag table from the last index to the first. For each entry set to one, it stores that index in a shared word and calls a routine.

name: clear_stripe_rows_with_setup
description: Picks two constants from a shared flag, then makes twenty passes that call routines and clear fifteen-row blocks across four bitplanes, moving down a row stride on each pass.

name: busy_wait_long_delay
description: Counts a 16-bit counter down from four thousand to below zero, doing no other work. It burns a longer fixed amount of time than the short delay routines.

name: start_blit_rows_modulo_ten
description: Programs the blitter with fixed control values and a modulo of ten, then starts five blits of the same size at destination offsets spaced far apart, loading the pointers from the calls.

name: copy_table_to_work_buffer
description: Copies five thousand nine hundred twenty-five longwords from a fixed table into a working buffer, one longword per step.

name: restore_table_from_work_buffer
description: Copies the same five thousand nine hundred twenty-five longwords back from the working buffer into the fixed table, the reverse of its neighbour.

name: initialize_display_and_copper
description: Writes fixed values to the display window, data fetch, bitplane, copper list pointer, DMA and interrupt enable registers, setting up the video hardware at startup.

name: start_two_fixed_buffer_blits
description: Programs the blitter with zero offsets and a fixed control value, then starts two blits of the same size, each to one of two fixed destination addresses.

name: start_blit_triplet_from_base
description: Programs the blitter with a zero-offset control and a modulo of ten, then starts three blits of a fixed size, computing each destination pointer from a shared base plus a fixed offset.

name: start_blit_triplet_from_constants
description: Programs the blitter similarly, with a modulo of ten on the destination, and starts a series of blits whose pointers are fixed constants or derived from the shared base.

name: copy_and_merge_row_block
description: Copies a block of thirty-two longwords for each of one hundred rows from a fixed table into a buffer, then ORs four source words together into each of sixteen destination words in a second buffer.

name: copy_and_merge_table_block
description: Copies a block of one thousand twenty-four longwords from a fixed table into a working area, then ORs groups of four consecutive source words together into a destination table, continuing for a further pass.

name: copy_indexed_blocks_with_counts
description: Walks twenty-two entries that each give a source pointer, a destination and a count, and copies the stored words across the rows of each block.

name: run_four_step_sequence
description: Calls four routines in a fixed order and returns.

name: check_record_high_bit_flag
description: Looks at a four-entry record chosen by an index. If its first entry is the end marker it calls a routine and returns; otherwise it checks the last of the four entries, and when that entry has its top bit set it sets a shared flag, calling a routine on each entry.

name: check_record_high_bit_flag
description: Same top-bit check as its neighbour, without the end-marker test, over four entries spaced four bytes apart.

name: start_single_blit_modulo_ten
description: Programs the blitter with fixed control values and a modulo of ten, loads source and destination pointers from the call, and starts a blit of a fixed size.

name: draw_line_octant_blit
description: Works out the octant and step counts for a line between two points, using absolute differences and sign tests, then programs the blitter to draw the line, with the octant code selecting the blitter mode.

name: configure_cia_port_registers
description: Writes fixed values to CIA port and control registers, sets a shared byte to a fixed value and clears a counter.

name: poll_input_state_byte
description: Updates a shared input state byte from a port reading, sets a control bit when a press is seen, and decrements a shared countdown. It returns the state byte and then clears it.

name: clear_event_record_table
description: Zeroes fifty consecutive longwords starting at a fixed table address.

name: store_event_record_slot
description: Stores six values into one slot of a ten-slot table, chosen by the shared counter modulo ten. Each slot is twenty bytes long.

name: store_event_slot_marker
description: Writes the shared counter value into the final word of the current slot in the same ten-slot table, marking that slot.

name: configure_interrupt_enable_bits
description: Writes an interrupt enable value that switches one interrupt source on, then a value that clears all interrupt enable bits, disabling interrupts.

name: wait_for_raster_line
description: Spins until the vertical beam position register reads a fixed value, waiting for the display to reach a given raster line.

name: poll_raster_line_with_delay
description: Sets a counter to zero, then steps it one at a time with a short pause between steps until the beam position reads a fixed raster line.

name: measure_raster_wait_iterations
description: Counts how many delayed polling passes it takes for the beam position to reach a fixed raster line, then sets a shared flag to zero or one depending on whether that count is small.

name: copy_byte_run_from_pattern
description: Copies bytes from a pattern region, offset by five thousand, into a destination buffer for a run length taken from a record, repeating passes until the destination is filled. It then sets a shared flag to a completion value.

name: start_disk_transfer_setup
description: Sets the disk sync word, DMA pointer and length registers, choosing one of two sets of values based on a shared state byte, and then starts a disk transfer.

name: set_background_color_value
description: Writes to the background color register. The decompiler output was unavailable, so the description rests on that register touch, the seven calls and the single caller.

name: collect_matching_table_entries
description: Scans a four-row table, comparing each entry's high word with a shared value, and stores the address and index of every matching entry into a list before returning.

name: initialize_disk_drive_ports
description: Sets a disk length register and writes fixed values to the disk and CIA port registers to prepare the drive, then calls three routines.

name: wait_for_interrupt_request_bit
description: Spins until bit one of the interrupt request register is set, then sets a shared state word to two and returns the bit value.

name: step_drive_head_to_track
description: Sets the drive direction bit from the sign of the difference between a target track and the current track, then steps the head one track at a time, calling a routine for each step and recording the new position.

name: step_head_one_track
description: Advances the current track by one. On even tracks it sets the side select bits and calls a routine, and on odd tracks it clears them. It returns the half-track position.

name: pulse_drive_until_flag_clear
description: Sets a drive control bit, then repeatedly pulses a step line and calls a routine while bit four of a shared flag remains set. It finishes by setting a further control bit and clearing the flag.

name: set_drive_control_bits_high
description: Updates the drive control port by setting two control bits.

name: set_drive_select_bits
description: Sets two control bits in the drive control port, leaving the other bits unchanged.

name: clear_drive_control_bits
description: Clears two control bits in the drive control port, then calls one routine.

name: repeat_until_routine_returns_zero
description: Calls one routine repeatedly until it returns zero.

name: wait_for_drive_status_edge
description: Waits until bit four of a drive status port is clear, then waits until it is set again, which spans one status transition.

name: sum_word_array
description: Adds up a run of words starting at a pointer and returns the total. The number of words is one more than the input count.

name: decode_bits_into_byte_run
description: For each word in a run, shifts a bit accumulator eight times and stores one bit per word as a byte, looping over the count given in the input. It is a bit-extraction step.

name: search_table_for_value
description: If a shared word matches a fixed sentinel, scans a table from a fixed address until it finds the given value. Otherwise it does nothing.

name: start_disk_dma_with_sync
description: Waits for a prior step, then sets the disk sync word, DMA pointer and length registers to fixed values and to the given sync word, and starts a disk transfer.

name: busy_wait_very_long_delay
description: Counts a 16-bit counter down from six thousand to below zero, doing no other work, which burns a long fixed amount of time.

name: repeat_pair_of_calls
description: Calls one routine once, then calls two routines on each pass of a loop run for a count taken from the input.

name: build_sector_header_records
description: Builds four sector records in memory, each with sync marks, a track value, a sector value and a checksum from a routine, and copies in a run of 512 words after each header.

name: start_disk_write_after_flag
description: Waits until bit eight of a shared flag is set, then sets the disk sync word and DMA registers to fixed values, starts a transfer, and clears the DMA pointer afterwards.

name: fill_pattern_buffer_then_start
description: Fills an eight-thousand-word buffer with an alternating bit pattern, repeats the fill until a shared flag bit is set, then starts a disk transfer with fixed register values.

name: fill_pattern_buffer_repeated
description: Repeats a fill of an eight-thousand-word buffer with an alternating bit pattern for a count taken from the input. Each time the flag bit is clear it calls routines, and it finishes by starting a disk transfer.

name: initialize_sector_buffer_fill
description: Fills a 512-word buffer with a fixed fill word, clears eight shared words, and then builds records in a loop, storing values from the shared words and calling a routine for each one.

name: encode_bytes_as_mfm_words
description: For each input byte, shifts its bits out one at a time and builds a 16-bit word with clock bits inserted between the data bits, storing one word per byte. It is a bit-level encoding step, as used for disk data.

name: set_background_color_word
description: Stores the input word into a shared state word used for the background color register and returns.

name: set_selector_and_run_sequence
description: Calls one routine, sets a shared selector to forty-five thousand, then calls six more routines in a row.

name: initialize_display_registers_variant
description: Points the copper list pointer at a shared buffer, then writes display window, fetch and bitplane modulo registers to fixed values. It is similar to the startup routine but does not perform the interrupt enable step.

name: forward_call_to_routine
description: A short entry that calls one routine and returns the register values unchanged.

name: silence_audio_channels
description: Clears the four audio channel volume registers and sets a few shared audio values to zero or to fixed values.

name: service_active_audio_channels
description: Calls one routine for each of four audio channel flags that is set.

name: build_audio_sample_table
description: Walks a sample list and, for each entry, stores a pointer to its data, a halved length, a period derived from a clock constant divided by a rate, and a volume scaled from fifty. It runs only when a flag byte is zero.

name: start_audio_channel_playback
description: Stops the chosen audio channel, selects its sample by index, computes its playback values and starts the channel with its DMA-enable bit. It calls two routines along the way.

name: busy_wait_medium_delay
description: Counts a 16-bit counter down from five hundred twelve to below zero, doing no other work, which burns a short fixed time.

name: update_channel_volume_envelope
description: Steps a channel's volume envelope. When its counter runs down it looks up a step from a table, adds it to the current volume, clamps the result at a fixed limit and writes it to the channel's volume register; otherwise it resets the envelope.

key: ghouls 'n ghosts (1989)(u. s. gold)[cr family]/Ghouls 'N Ghosts (1989)(U. S. Gold)[cr Family].adf:c/picend:0:0000
name: start_entry_open_libraries
description: Program entry that saves register state, opens the system libraries it needs, and stores their base addresses in shared globals. It runs the main routine only if every library opens; if one fails it sets a failure return code of twenty.

key: ghouls 'n ghosts (1989)(u. s. gold)[cr family]/Ghouls 'N Ghosts (1989)(U. S. Gold)[cr Family].adf:c/picend:0:0004
name: write_null_terminated_text
description: Measures a null-terminated text string and, when it is not empty, calls a system library routine to write it out.

key: ghouls 'n ghosts (1989)(u. s. gold)[cr family]/Ghouls 'N Ghosts (1989)(U. S. Gold)[cr Family].adf:c/picend:0:0028
name: read_file_via_dos_library
description: Locks and examines a named file, opens it, and reads its contents with the system file routines, then closes and unlocks it. It returns early when the examination fails.

key: ghouls 'n ghosts (1989)(u. s. gold)[cr family]/Ghouls 'N Ghosts (1989)(U. S. Gold)[cr Family].adf:c/picend:0:00EE
name: close_file_and_finish
description: Closes a file through the system file routines, then calls one routine and returns.

key: ghouls 'n ghosts (1989)(u. s. gold)[cr family]/Ghouls 'N Ghosts (1989)(U. S. Gold)[cr Family].adf:c/picend:0:0108
name: allocate_tracked_memory_block
description: Allocates a memory block through the system memory routine and, if the allocation succeeds, stores the requested size plus four in its first longword.

key: ghouls 'n ghosts (1989)(u. s. gold)[cr family]/Ghouls 'N Ghosts (1989)(U. S. Gold)[cr Family].adf:c/picend:0:012A
name: free_memory_block_if_set
description: Frees a memory block through the system memory routine when the pointer passed in is not null.

key: ghouls 'n ghosts (1989)(u. s. gold)[cr family]/Ghouls 'N Ghosts (1989)(U. S. Gold)[cr Family].adf:c/picend:0:0156
name: terminate_text_buffer
description: When a flag in a shared structure is set, records the buffer pointer and writes a zero byte at the end of the buffer, terminating the string.

key: ghouls 'n ghosts (1989)(u. s. gold)[cr family]/Ghouls 'N Ghosts (1989)(U. S. Gold)[cr Family].adf:c/picend:0:016E
name: read_next_text_token
description: Advances through a shared text pointer, skipping spaces, and returns the next token. A quoted token ends at its closing quote; otherwise a token ends at a comma or at the end of the string.
